title: Why constrained English
summary: A small grammar that reads like prose and compiles to plain HTML.
body: Every sentence in Kadam matches exactly one template, so a page either compiles or tells you which line is wrong and why.

title: Build-time data
summary: Lists and pages from JSON files, checked before anything is written.
body: A data file is just more source. Field names are checked against every sentence that reads them, and the output is still static HTML.

title: A runtime you can read
summary: State and dialogs without a framework.
body: Pages that need state get one generated module with only the effects they use, and keep working with JavaScript off.
